changes.item: held-out predictor ranges may not influence candidate filtering

changes.justified_on: conceptual - unnecessary under the finite-object claim

changes.from: per-fold, rebuilt from D_train at tau_train = 0.5 (2217-2352 coords)
changes.to: common C_E2_FULL_DOMAIN, K2-certified over all 62 (3451 coords)
expected to pass by construction; retained as an INTEGRITY CHECK

epistemic_effect: E2.0's stricter rule would have tested TWO things on held-out data: whether the target relationship transfers, AND whether the support's predictor geometry holds up on discharges whose ranges were never consulted. E2.0A tests only the first; the second is now satisfied by construction. A positive Epoch-2 result is therefore a WEAKER statement than E2.0 would have produced, and the claim boundary must say so

e2_0_feasibility_estimate.value: roughly 1 in 5 six-fold applicability under random draws
